Change requests; updates to plans and baselines; updates to the risk register, risk report, schedule and forecasts.
The person who maintains continuity on a risk and acts on its response.
Outside the project's scope or beyond the PM's authority; managed at a higher level that must accept ownership.
Eliminates a threat (probability to zero) or isolates objectives from it: remove the cause, reduce scope, change strategy.
Shifts a threat's ownership and impact to a third party, often for a premium: insurance, bonds, warranties.
Reduces a threat's probability and/or impact: more tests, simpler processes, a prototype, redundancy.
Active: a contingency reserve. Passive: no action except periodic review.
Makes sure an opportunity happens (probability to 100%): best people, new technology.
Gives an opportunity to a third party best able to capture it: partnerships, joint ventures.
Raises an opportunity's probability and/or impact, e.g. adding resources to finish early.
Remove high-risk scope; if the project cannot get back within thresholds, it may be canceled.
Add high-benefit scope, or change thresholds with key stakeholders' agreement.
Replan, change scope, priority, resources or delivery times.
A contingency or fallback plan carried out only when a trigger condition occurs.
Risk that remains after planned responses, or that was deliberately accepted.
A risk that arises directly from implementing a risk response.
Makes sure agreed responses are executed as planned; tools: expert judgment, influencing, PMIS.
Tracks risks and responses, identifies new risks, evaluates effectiveness; keeps risk owners assigned.
Technical performance analysis, reserve analysis, audits, meetings.
Actual technical results (weight, transaction times, defects) against the plan.
Examines the effectiveness of the risk management process; the PM makes sure it happens as planned.
Analyzes the status of existing risks and identifies new ones; also called a risk reassessment.
Risk register (owner, response, status), risk report (sources, trends), work performance information.
